name: ThreatCluster Public API
description:
## ThreatCluster Public API

Programmatic access to threat intelligence data.

### Authentication

All endpoints require an API key passed via the `X-API-Key` header:

```
X-API-Key: tc_live_your_api_key_here
```

Every account — including **Free** — can mint a key in [Settings → API](/settings#api).
No card needed. Overview, quickstart and examples: [threatcluster.io/about/api](/about/api).
Client examples and an OpenAPI snapshot: [github.com/Jam0k/threatcluster-api](https://github.com/Jam0k/threatcluster-api).

### Plans, scopes and rate limits

Keys carry scopes; each endpoint declares the scope it needs (a `403 insufficient_scope`
tells you which). Budgets are per key.

| Plan | Requests | Scopes on a new key |
|------|----------|---------------------|
| Free | 30 / min, **100 credits / day** | `threats:read` `iocs:read` `entities:read` `vulns:read` `darkweb:read` |
| Researcher | 120 / min | + `feeds:read` `feeds:write` `alerts:read` `alerts:write` |
| Analyst | 240 / min | same as Researcher |
| Business / MSSP | 600 / min | all scopes (+ `mssp:*`) |

**Free keys see a 7-day window and spend a weighted daily budget.** Time filters are clamped to the
window (`time_filter` ≤ 7d, `hours` ≤ 168, `days` ≤ 7, `weeks` ≤ 1), by-id lookups of older records return
`403 lookback_exceeded`, list requests return at most 25 rows, and rows are trimmed: the short summary (not
the enhanced one), threat score + urgency (not the sub-scores or severity reasoning), a 3-event timeline,
source links without article bodies, secondary lists capped at 10.

The daily allowance is **100 credits**, not 100 requests. Records and lists cost 1; bulk and fan-out
requests (IOC feed and export, STIX bundles, dark-web keyword hits and trends) cost 3; `/search` costs 5;
a dark-web victim enrichment record costs 10. Every budgeted response
carries `X-Request-Cost`; free keys also get `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and
`X-RateLimit-Reset` (next 00:00 UTC) so a script or an agent can pace itself. A request that finds nothing costs nothing:
an empty `/search`, an empty keyword sweep or a 404 lookup refunds its credits and returns
`X-Request-Cost: 0`. Exhausting the budget returns
`429 daily_budget_exceeded` with `Retry-After`. Responses carry `"tier": "free"` and `"lookback_days": 7`
so you can tell. Researcher gets the full record, the full history and 1,000 credits a day;
credit packs cover the overage for any budgeted tier. Business and MSSP have no daily budget.

**Start with `GET /search?q=<term>`** — one call across clusters, entities and the dark web; chain the
`short_id` / `entity_type` + `entity_value` it returns into the detail endpoints.

Over budget returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header. Per-key overrides above the plan
ceiling are available for platform integrations — contact hello@threatcluster.io.

### Base URL

```
https://threatcluster.io/api/public/v1
```
